description: This file defines an abstract API class for managing temporary cache entries in the Superset application, including methods for CRUD operations and API schema registration.

classes.name: TemporaryCacheRestApi
classes.description: An abstract base class for REST API endpoints managing temporary cache data, providing CRUD methods and API schema integration.

methods.name: add_apispec_components
methods.description: Adds schema components to the API specification, handling duplicate component names gracefully.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles creation of a new cache entry, returning the key or error messages.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Updates an existing cache entry identified by key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a cache entry by key.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry by key.

methods.name: get_create_command
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the command for creating cache entries.

methods.name: get_update_command
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the command for updating cache entries.

methods.name: get_get_command
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the command for fetching cache entries.

methods.name: get_delete_command
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the command for deleting cache entries.
